name: Lifelong Learning
grammar: Reported speech: orders, requests, offers and advice
Reported speech (ôn tập: statements and questions)

notes.title: Câu tường thuật: mệnh lệnh, yêu cầu, lời mời/đề nghị giúp, lời khuyên
notes.body:
Khi tường thuật mệnh lệnh, yêu cầu, đề nghị giúp đỡ, lời khuyên ta thường dùng ĐỘNG TỪ TƯỜNG THUẬT + (tân ngữ) + TO-V; phủ định: NOT TO-V.
• Mệnh lệnh: tell / order sb (not) to V
  "Turn off your phones." → The teacher told us to turn off our phones.
  "Don't be late!" → He told me not to be late.
• Yêu cầu (please, can/could you…?, would you mind…?): ask sb (not) to V
  "Could you help me with this form, please?" → She asked me to help her with the form.
• Đề nghị giúp (I'll…, Shall I…?, Would you like me to…?): offer to V (KHÔNG có tân ngữ sau offer)
  "Shall I carry your bag?" → He offered to carry my bag.
• Lời khuyên (You should…, You'd better…, If I were you, I'd…): advise sb (not) to V; hoặc said (that) sb should V
  "You should take an online course." → She advised me to take an online course.
• Nhớ đổi đại từ, tính từ sở hữu, trạng từ thời gian/nơi chốn (now → then, here → there, tomorrow → the next day…).
Lỗi hay gặp: *said me to… (phải told me to…); *offered me to help (phải offered to help me); *told him don't… / *not stop (phải not to stop); *suggested me to… (suggest không đi với sb + to V).

notes.title: Ôn tập: tường thuật câu kể và câu hỏi
notes.body:
• Câu kể: say (that) / tell sb (that) + mệnh đề lùi thì: hiện tại đơn → quá khứ đơn; hiện tại tiếp diễn → quá khứ tiếp diễn; hiện tại hoàn thành / quá khứ đơn → quá khứ hoàn thành; will → would; can → could.
  "I am taking an English course now." → He said (that) he was taking an English course then.
• Câu hỏi Yes/No: ask (sb) if/whether + S + V (lùi thì), KHÔNG đảo ngữ, không dấu hỏi.
  "Do you want to join our club?" → She asked me if I wanted to join their club.
• Câu hỏi Wh-: ask (sb) + Wh- + S + V (lùi thì).
  "Where can I find information?" → She asked where she could find information.
Lỗi hay gặp: giữ trật tự câu hỏi (*asked where could she find); dùng 'or no' thay vì 'or not'; quên đổi đại từ.

notes.title: Ngữ điệu trong câu hỏi (ôn tập)
notes.body:
• Câu hỏi Yes/No: thường LÊN giọng (↗) ở cuối. Do you enjoy learning new things? ↗
• Câu hỏi Wh- (what, where, why, how…): thường XUỐNG giọng (↘) ở cuối. Why did he go back to university? ↘
• Câu hỏi lựa chọn (A or B?): lên giọng ở lựa chọn thứ nhất, xuống giọng ở lựa chọn cuối. Do you prefer learning online ↗ or in a classroom? ↘
• Câu hỏi đuôi: xuống giọng khi người nói chắc chắn, chờ xác nhận; lên giọng khi không chắc, thật sự hỏi.
Mẹo: xác định loại câu hỏi trước (từ để hỏi hay trợ động từ đứng đầu? có 'or' nối hai lựa chọn không?).

notes.title: Collocation / cụm từ cần nhớ
notes.body: lifelong learning / lifelong learner • acquire knowledge / skills • pursue a degree / a hobby • keep up with technology / changes • stay up to date • broaden your horizons • take up a hobby / a course • enrol in a course • drop out of school / a course • self-motivated / self-directed learner • personal development / self-improvement • a voluntary course (≠ compulsory) • distance learning / online course / adult education • improve your employability / career prospects • keep your mind active • a growth mindset • time management skills • a sense of fulfilment • be a role model for sb

notes.title: Mẹo làm bài
notes.body:
• Tường thuật: nhìn câu trực tiếp để chọn động từ: mệnh lệnh → told/ordered sb to V; Please/Could you → asked sb to V; I'll/Shall I → offered to V; You should/If I were you → advised sb to V. Phủ định luôn là NOT TO V.
• Loại nhanh phương án: 'said me', 'offered sb to V', 'suggested sb to V', 'told sb don't' đều sai.
• Câu hỏi tường thuật: không đảo ngữ, lùi thì, dùng if/whether cho Yes/No.
• Từ vựng: nhớ các phrasal verb chủ đề học tập: take up, keep up with, drop out of, sign up for, give up.
• Ngữ điệu: Yes/No ↗, Wh- ↘, câu lựa chọn ↗…↘.

vocab.ex: Learning should be a lifelong process.
Lifelong learning helps people adapt to a changing world.
My grandmother is a true lifelong learner.

vocab.vi: tự tạo động lực, tự giác
vocab.ex: Self-motivated learners don't need anyone to push them.
Self-directed learning means you plan and manage your own study.
He improved his English through self-study.

vocab.vi: sự tự hoàn thiện bản thân
vocab.ex: She reads books on self-improvement every week.
Learning new skills contributes to personal development.

vocab.vi: thu nhận, đạt được (kiến thức, kỹ năng)
vocab.ex: You can acquire new skills at any age.
She decided to pursue a master's degree at 50.
Workers need training to keep up with new technology.
Doctors must keep their knowledge up to date.
Some of the skills I learnt at school are now outdated.
Lifelong learning is voluntary and self-motivated.
Online courses offer flexible study hours.
Distance learning is popular among working adults.
The centre offers adult education courses in the evening.
My uncle enrolled in an accounting course.
Lack of motivation makes many learners drop out of online courses.

vocab.vi: bắt đầu (một sở thích, môn học)
vocab.ex: After retiring, he took up painting.
Travelling and reading broaden your horizons.

vocab.vi: sự tò mò, ham hiểu biết
vocab.ex: Curiosity is the key to lifelong learning.
Stay curious and keep asking questions.
Motivation is important for adult learners.
She got a teaching qualification at the age of 45.
Learning new skills improves your employability.
A second language can improve your career prospects.
Companies encourage employees to upskill regularly.
A growth mindset helps you learn from mistakes.

vocab.vi: cởi mở, sẵn sàng tiếp thu
vocab.ex: Lifelong learners are usually open-minded.
Studying while working requires strong commitment.
Good time management helps you balance work and study.

vocab.vi: xoay xở (làm nhiều việc cùng lúc)
vocab.ex: Many adult learners juggle work, family and study.
Lack of time is a major challenge of lifelong learning.
He started learning English after his retirement.
She became one of the oldest university graduates.

vocab.vi: học sinh vừa tốt nghiệp phổ thông
vocab.ex: The head teacher gave advice to school-leavers.
The head teacher wrote a message to school-leavers.
My grandfather is a great role model for lifelong learning.

vocab.vi: sự mãn nguyện, cảm giác viên mãn
vocab.ex: Learning gives many older people a sense of fulfilment.

vocab.vi: sức khỏe, hạnh phúc (thể chất và tinh thần)
vocab.ex: Learning new things is good for your well-being.
Young people should embrace new learning opportunities.

passages.title: Learning never stops
passages.text: In today's fast-changing world, what we learn at school is no longer enough for a whole career. That is (1) _____ more and more people are becoming lifelong learners. Lifelong learning is the voluntary and self-motivated pursuit of knowledge for personal or professional reasons. It does not always (2) _____ place in a classroom. People can learn from online courses, books, podcasts, or even from their colleagues at work. Learning new skills helps workers keep (3) _____ with new technology and improves their career prospects. It also brings personal benefits. People (4) _____ continue learning throughout their lives often feel more confident and satisfied with what they do. Experts (5) _____ young people to develop good learning habits while they are still at school, so that they will be ready to adapt to any changes in the future.

passages.title: Never too old to learn
passages.text: When Mrs Hoa retired at the age of 60, she felt bored and lonely. Her granddaughter (6) _____ that she join a free computer course at the local community centre. At first, Mrs Hoa was worried that she was too old to learn, but her teacher told her (7) _____ about her age. After a few weeks, she could send emails, search for information and video-call her relatives abroad. Encouraged by her (8) _____, she then took up an online English course. 'Learning keeps my mind active and makes me feel young again,' she says. Today, Mrs Hoa is a role model for many people in her neighbourhood. She often offers (9) _____ other older people use their smartphones. Her story shows that it is never too late to learn, (10) _____ you are curious and willing to try.

questions.q: Lifelong learning means _____.
options: studying one subject for a long time
learning only while you are at school
continuing to learn throughout your life
studying only to get a university degree
questions.explain: lifelong learning = học tập suốt đời, tức là tiếp tục học trong suốt cuộc đời, không chỉ ở trường hay chỉ để lấy bằng.

questions.q: A _____ learner does not need other people to push him or her to study.
questions.explain: self-motivated = tự tạo động lực, tự giác. self-employed: tự kinh doanh; self-centred: ích kỷ; self-conscious: ngượng ngùng, e dè.

questions.q: In a fast-changing world, workers need to _____ new skills to keep their jobs.
questions.explain: acquire skills = tiếp thu, đạt được kỹ năng. require: đòi hỏi; inquire: hỏi thăm; admire: ngưỡng mộ — không hợp nghĩa.

questions.q: After retiring, many people _____ new hobbies such as painting or gardening.
questions.explain: take up = bắt đầu (một sở thích, hoạt động mới). take off: cất cánh/cởi ra; take after: giống (người thân); take over: tiếp quản.

questions.q: It is hard to _____ the latest technology because it changes so quickly.
questions.explain: keep up with = theo kịp. get on with: hòa hợp/tiếp tục; put up with: chịu đựng; come up with: nghĩ ra.

questions.q: Learning a foreign language can help you _____ your horizons and understand other cultures.
questions.explain: Collocation: broaden one's horizons = mở rộng tầm hiểu biết. Các động từ còn lại không đi với 'horizons'.

questions.q: Children have a natural _____ about the world around them.
questions.explain: Sau tính từ 'natural' và mạo từ 'a' cần danh từ → curiosity (sự tò mò). curious/uncurious là tính từ, curiously là trạng từ.

questions.q: Lack of _____ is one of the main reasons why many learners drop out of online courses.
questions.explain: Sau 'lack of' cần danh từ → motivation (động lực). motivate: động từ; motivated, motivational: tính từ.

questions.q: Online courses are popular because they are _____: learners can study at any time and in any place.
questions.explain: flexible = linh hoạt, phù hợp với vế giải thích 'học bất cứ lúc nào, ở đâu'. fixed: cố định; strict: nghiêm khắc; formal: chính quy — trái ý.

questions.q: My uncle _____ in an evening course in accounting last month.
questions.explain: enrol in a course = ghi danh vào khóa học. attend và enter là ngoại động từ, không dùng 'in'; admit nghĩa là thừa nhận/cho vào, không hợp.

questions.q: Since this is a _____ course, nobody forces you to take it.
questions.explain: voluntary = tự nguyện, phù hợp 'không ai bắt buộc bạn học'. compulsory/obligatory/mandatory đều nghĩa là bắt buộc — mâu thuẫn với vế sau.

questions.q:
Choose the word CLOSEST in meaning to the underlined word.
Older people who keep learning often find a sense of <u>fulfilment</u> in their lives.
questions.explain: fulfilment = sự mãn nguyện ≈ satisfaction (sự hài lòng). disappointment: thất vọng; pressure: áp lực; boredom: buồn chán.

questions.q:
Choose the word(s) CLOSEST in meaning to the underlined word.
She decided to <u>pursue</u> a master's degree at the age of 50.
questions.explain: pursue = theo đuổi ≈ try to achieve (cố gắng đạt được). give up: từ bỏ; put off: trì hoãn; turn down: từ chối.

questions.q:
Choose the word(s) OPPOSITE in meaning to the underlined word.
Many adults worry that their knowledge will become <u>outdated</u> quickly.
questions.explain: outdated = lỗi thời, trái nghĩa là up to date (cập nhật). old-fashioned là đồng nghĩa; useless, limited không phải trái nghĩa.

questions.q:
Choose the word OPPOSITE in meaning to the underlined phrase.
Thanks to his strong commitment, he never <u>dropped out of</u> the evening course.
questions.explain: drop out of = bỏ học giữa chừng, trái nghĩa là completed (hoàn thành). left và quit gần nghĩa với drop out; missed: bỏ lỡ.

questions.q: A _____ mindset helps learners see mistakes as opportunities to improve.
questions.explain: growth mindset = tư duy phát triển, coi sai lầm là cơ hội tiến bộ. fixed/closed/narrow mindset mang nghĩa ngược lại.

questions.q: A student who has just finished secondary school is called a _____.
questions.explain: school-leaver = học sinh vừa tốt nghiệp phổ thông. head teacher: hiệu trưởng; lecturer: giảng viên; dropout: người bỏ học giữa chừng.

questions.q: Good _____ management skills help adult learners plan their study time effectively.
questions.explain: time management = quản lý thời gian, phù hợp 'lên kế hoạch thời gian học'. risk/waste/crisis management không liên quan.

questions.q: Lifelong learning can improve your _____ because employers value workers who keep developing their skills.
questions.explain: Sau tính từ sở hữu 'your' cần danh từ; nghĩa phù hợp: employability = khả năng được tuyển dụng. employer: người thuê; unemployment: thất nghiệp; 'improve your employment' không tự nhiên.

questions.q: Studies show that learning new things keeps older people's minds _____ and healthy.
questions.explain: keep one's mind active = giữ đầu óc minh mẫn, năng động. passive/lazy/idle mang nghĩa tiêu cực, trái với 'healthy'.

questions.topic: Reported speech: orders, requests, offers and advice
questions.q:
"Turn off your phones," the teacher said to us.
→ The teacher told us _____ our phones.
questions.explain: Mệnh lệnh: tell sb to V. Không dùng V nguyên mẫu trần, V-ing hay 'that' sau 'told us' trong trường hợp này.

questions.topic: Reported speech: orders, requests, offers and advice
questions.q:
"Don't be late for the workshop," the trainer said to Nam.
→ The trainer told Nam _____ late for the workshop.
questions.explain: Mệnh lệnh phủ định: tell sb NOT TO V → not to be late. 'don't be' giữ nguyên câu trực tiếp; 'not be', 'to be not' sai cấu trúc.

questions.topic: Reported speech: orders, requests, offers and advice
questions.q:
"Could you help me with my online course?" my grandmother asked me.
→ My grandmother asked me _____ her with her online course.
questions.explain: Yêu cầu: ask sb to V → asked me to help her.

questions.topic: Reported speech: orders, requests, offers and advice
questions.q:
"I'll show you how to use this app," Minh said to his father.
→ Minh _____ to show his father how to use the app.
questions.explain: Câu 'I'll…' là lời đề nghị giúp → offer to V (không có tân ngữ). advised/ordered/told phải có tân ngữ trước to V và sai nghĩa.

questions.topic: Reported speech: orders, requests, offers and advice
questions.q:
"You should read more books to broaden your knowledge," the librarian said to us.
→ The librarian advised us _____ more books to broaden our knowledge.
questions.explain: Lời khuyên: advise sb to V → advised us to read.
questions.review: Lớp 12 · Unit 10 – Language, Grammar (ôn ở Looking Back)

questions.topic: Reported speech: orders, requests, offers and advice
questions.q: The head teacher advised school-leavers _____ learning after they graduated.
questions.explain: advise sb NOT TO V → not to stop. Các phương án khác sai cấu trúc.

questions.topic: Reported speech: orders, requests, offers and advice
questions.q:
"Shall I send you the link to the course?" Lan said to me.
→ Lan _____ the link to the course.
questions.explain: 'Shall I…?' là đề nghị giúp → offer to V: offered to send me. 'offered me to send', 'suggested me to send' sai cấu trúc; 'asked me to send' sai nghĩa (thành tôi gửi).

questions.topic: Reported speech: orders, requests, offers and advice
questions.q:
"Please fill in this enrolment form," the receptionist said to my mother.
→ The receptionist _____ my mother to fill in the enrolment form.
questions.explain: Câu có 'please' là lời yêu cầu → ask sb to V. said không đi với sb + to V; offered không có tân ngữ; suggest không dùng suggest sb to V.

questions.topic: Reported speech: orders, requests, offers and advice
questions.q:
"If I were you, I would take a course in time management," my sister said to me.
→ My sister _____ a course in time management.
questions.explain: 'If I were you, I would…' là lời khuyên → advise sb to V. Các phương án còn lại sai cấu trúc.

questions.topic: Reported speech: orders, requests, offers and advice
questions.q:
"Stand in line and wait for your turn!" the guard said to the visitors.
→ The guard _____ the visitors to stand in line and wait for their turn.
questions.explain: Câu mệnh lệnh mạnh (có dấu !) → order sb to V. offered/suggested/explained không dùng với cấu trúc sb + to V.
questions.review: Lớp 12 · Unit 10 – Language, Grammar (ôn ở Looking Back)

questions.topic: Reported speech (ôn tập: statements and questions)
questions.q:
"I am taking an English course at the moment," Huy said.
→ Huy said that he _____ an English course at that moment.
questions.explain: Câu kể tường thuật lùi thì: hiện tại tiếp diễn → quá khứ tiếp diễn: was taking (at the moment → at that moment).

questions.topic: Reported speech (ôn tập: statements and questions)
questions.q:
"Where can I find information about adult education courses?" she asked.
→ She asked where _____ information about adult education courses.
questions.explain: Câu hỏi Wh- tường thuật: Wh- + S + V, không đảo ngữ, lùi thì can → could: where she could find.

questions.topic: Reported speech (ôn tập: statements and questions)
questions.q:
"Do you want to join our reading club?" Mai asked me.
→ Mai asked me _____ to join their reading club.
questions.explain: Câu hỏi Yes/No tường thuật: ask sb if/whether + S + V (lùi thì) → if I wanted. Không đảo ngữ; không dùng 'that'.

questions.topic: Reported speech: orders, requests, offers and advice
questions.q:
"Remember to update your CV regularly," the career adviser said to the students.
→ The career adviser reminded the students _____ their CVs regularly.
questions.explain: remind sb to V = nhắc ai làm gì → reminded the students to update.

questions.topic: Reported speech: orders, requests, offers and advice
questions.q:
"Can you speak more slowly, please?" the old man said to the tutor.
→ The old man asked the tutor _____ more slowly.
questions.explain: Lời yêu cầu (Can you…, please?) → ask sb to V: asked the tutor to speak.
questions.review: Lớp 12 · Unit 10 – Language, Grammar (ôn ở Looking Back)

questions.topic: Reported speech: orders, requests, offers and advice
questions.q:
"You'd better not give up your studies," Dad said to my brother.
→ Dad advised my brother _____ his studies.
questions.explain: 'You'd better not…' là lời khuyên phủ định → advise sb not to V: not to give up.

questions.topic: Reported speech: orders, requests, offers and advice
questions.q:
"I can help you practise speaking English if you like," Tom said to his classmate.
→ Tom _____.
options: advised his classmate to help him practise speaking English
offered his classmate to help practise speaking English
offered to help his classmate practise speaking English
asked his classmate to help him practise speaking English
questions.explain: Tom đề nghị giúp bạn → offer to V + tân ngữ sau động từ chính: offered to help his classmate. 'offered his classmate to help' sai cấu trúc; advised/asked … to help him sai nghĩa (thành bạn giúp Tom).

questions.topic: Reported speech: orders, requests, offers and advice
questions.q:
"Please don't use your phones during the lecture," the lecturer said to us.
→ The lecturer asked us _____ our phones during the lecture.
questions.explain: Yêu cầu phủ định: ask sb not to V → not to use.

questions.topic: Reported speech: orders, requests, offers and advice
questions.q: The coach told us that we _____ practise every day if we wanted to improve.
questions.explain: Tường thuật lời khuyên bằng 'said/told (that) sb should V'. shall không dùng ở đây; 'must to' sai; 'ought' phải là 'ought to'.

questions.topic: Reported speech: orders, requests, offers and advice
questions.q:
"Would you like me to carry your books?" Nam said to the librarian.
→ Nam _____ the librarian's books.
questions.explain: 'Would you like me to…?' là lời đề nghị giúp → offer to V. 'offered carrying' sai dạng; advise/tell cần tân ngữ trước to V và sai nghĩa.
questions.review: Lớp 12 · Unit 10 – Language, Grammar (ôn ở Looking Back)

questions.q:
Choose the correct intonation for the following question.
"Have you ever taken an online course?"
options: Rising (↗) at the end, because it is a Yes/No question
Falling (↘) at the end, because it is a Yes/No question
Falling (↘) at the end, because it begins with an auxiliary verb
Rising (↗) and then falling (↘), because it is a choice question
questions.explain: Câu hỏi Yes/No (bắt đầu bằng trợ động từ Have) thường lên giọng ở cuối câu.

questions.q:
Choose the correct intonation for the following question.
"What skills would you like to learn after you leave school?"
options: Rising (↗) at the end, because it is a Wh-question
Falling (↘) at the end, because it is a Wh-question
Rising (↗) at the end, because it is a Yes/No question
Rising (↗) and then falling (↘), because it is a choice question
questions.explain: Câu hỏi Wh- (What…) thường xuống giọng ở cuối câu.

questions.q:
Choose the correct intonation for the following question.
"Do you prefer learning online or in a classroom?"
questions.explain: Câu hỏi lựa chọn (A or B?): lên giọng ở lựa chọn thứ nhất, xuống giọng ở lựa chọn cuối.

questions.q: Which question normally has a FALLING intonation at the end?
options: Can you speak any foreign languages?
Do you enjoy learning new things?
Why did your grandfather go back to university?
Is it ever too late to learn?
questions.explain: Câu hỏi Wh- (Why…?) thường xuống giọng; ba câu còn lại là câu hỏi Yes/No nên thường lên giọng.

questions.q: Choose the word whose underlined part is pronounced differently from the others.
questions.explain: motivated /ˈməʊtɪveɪtɪd/ đuôi -ed đọc /ɪd/ (sau âm /t/); acquired /əˈkwaɪəd/, enrolled /ɪnˈrəʊld/, pursued /pəˈsjuːd/ đọc /d/.

questions.q:
Find the underlined part that needs correction.
Lifelong learning <u>help</u> (A) people <u>keep up with</u> (B) changes <u>in</u> (C) <u>the modern world</u> (D).
questions.explain: Sai ở A: chủ ngữ 'Lifelong learning' số ít → helps.

questions.topic: Reported speech: orders, requests, offers and advice
questions.q:
Find the underlined part that needs correction.
The head teacher told <u>the students</u> (A) <u>not stop</u> (B) learning <u>after</u> (C) they <u>left</u> (D) school.
questions.explain: Sai ở B: tường thuật mệnh lệnh/lời khuyên phủ định: tell sb not to V → not to stop.

questions.topic: Reported speech: orders, requests, offers and advice
questions.q:
Find the underlined part that needs correction.
My brother <u>offered</u> (A) to teach our grandmother <u>how</u> (B) <u>using</u> (C) a smartphone <u>so that</u> (D) she could video-call her friends.
questions.explain: Sai ở C: how + to V → how to use.

questions.q:
Find the underlined part that needs correction.
Older people <u>who</u> (A) keep learning new skills <u>are often</u> (B) healthier and happier <u>than</u> (C) <u>that</u> (D) who stop learning.
questions.explain: Sai ở D: thay cho danh từ số nhiều 'older people' phải dùng those → than those who stop learning.

questions.topic: Reported speech (ôn tập: statements and questions)
questions.q:
Find the underlined part that needs correction.
She asked me <u>whether</u> (A) I <u>had ever taken</u> (B) an online course <u>before</u> (C) <u>or no</u> (D).
questions.explain: Sai ở D: whether … or not (không dùng 'or no').

questions.topic: Reported speech: orders, requests, offers and advice
questions.q:
Find the underlined part that needs correction.
The lecturer <u>asked</u> (A) us <u>to read</u> (B) the article <u>careful</u> (C) <u>before</u> (D) the next class.
questions.explain: Sai ở C: bổ nghĩa cho động từ 'read' cần trạng từ → carefully.

questions.q:
Find the underlined part that needs correction.
Despite <u>being</u> (A) 85 years old, Mr Lam <u>was decided</u> (B) <u>to pursue</u> (C) a degree <u>in</u> (D) history.
questions.explain: Sai ở B: ông Lam tự quyết định → chủ động: decided (to pursue).

questions.topic: Reported speech: orders, requests, offers and advice
questions.q:
Find the underlined part that needs correction.
My mother <u>said me</u> (A) <u>to sign up</u> (B) <u>for</u> (C) a cooking class <u>to improve</u> (D) my skills.
questions.explain: Sai ở A: 'say' không có tân ngữ người + to V → told me (to sign up).

questions.topic: Reported speech: orders, requests, offers and advice
questions.q:
Choose the sentence that is closest in meaning to the given sentence.
"Please turn off the lights when you leave the classroom," the teacher said to us.
options: The teacher asked us turn off the lights when we leave the classroom.
The teacher asked us to turn off the lights when we left the classroom.
The teacher offered to turn off the lights when we left the classroom.
The teacher asked us not to turn off the lights when we left the classroom.
questions.explain: Lời yêu cầu → asked sb to V, đổi you → we, lùi thì leave → left. Các câu khác sai cấu trúc (thiếu to), sai nghĩa (offered: cô tự tắt) hoặc ngược nghĩa (not to).

questions.topic: Reported speech: orders, requests, offers and advice
questions.q:
Choose the sentence that is closest in meaning to the given sentence.
"You should join a book club to improve your reading habit," my friend said to me.
options: My friend asked me why I joined a book club to improve my reading habit.
My friend advised me joining a book club to improve my reading habit.
My friend offered to join a book club to improve my reading habit.
My friend advised me to join a book club to improve my reading habit.
questions.explain: 'You should' = lời khuyên → advised sb to V. 'advised me joining' sai cấu trúc; offered và asked why sai nghĩa.

questions.topic: Reported speech: orders, requests, offers and advice
questions.q:
Choose the sentence that is closest in meaning to the given sentence.
"I'll lend you my notes from the workshop," Linh said to Hoa.
options: Linh offered to lend Hoa her notes from the workshop.
Linh asked Hoa to lend her the notes from the workshop.
Linh offered Hoa to lend her notes from the workshop.
Linh advised Hoa to lend her notes from the workshop.
questions.explain: 'I'll…' là lời đề nghị giúp → offered to lend Hoa her notes. 'offered Hoa to lend' sai cấu trúc; asked/advised Hoa to lend làm sai nghĩa (Hoa cho mượn).

questions.q:
Choose the sentence that is closest in meaning to the given sentence.
It is never too late to learn new things.
options: It is too late for older people to learn new things.
Only young people can learn new things.
People can learn new things at any age.
People should stop learning when they get old.
questions.explain: 'Không bao giờ quá muộn để học' = có thể học ở mọi lứa tuổi. Ba câu còn lại mang nghĩa ngược lại.

questions.topic: Reported speech: orders, requests, offers and advice
questions.q:
Choose the sentence that is closest in meaning to the given sentence.
"Don't give up your evening classes," the manager said to Tuan.
options: The manager asked Tuan whether he gave up his evening classes.
The manager told Tuan to give up his evening classes.
The manager told Tuan not give up his evening classes.
The manager told Tuan not to give up his evening classes.
questions.explain: Mệnh lệnh phủ định → told sb not to V; your → his. Câu 'to give up' ngược nghĩa; 'not give up' sai cấu trúc; câu hỏi whether sai nghĩa.

questions.q:
Choose the sentence that is closest in meaning to the given sentence.
Although she works full-time, she still takes an online course every term.
options: Despite working full-time, she still takes an online course every term.
Because she works full-time, she takes an online course every term.
Despite she works full-time, she still takes an online course every term.
In spite of work full-time, she still takes an online course every term.
questions.explain: Although + mệnh đề = Despite + V-ing/danh từ → Despite working full-time. 'Because' sai nghĩa; 'Despite she works' và 'In spite of work' sai cấu trúc.

questions.q:
Choose the sentence that best combines each pair of sentences.
Mr Binh retired last year. He has enrolled in a painting course.
options: Mr Binh, who retired last year, he has enrolled in a painting course.
Mr Binh, that retired last year, has enrolled in a painting course.
Mr Binh, who retired last year, has enrolled in a painting course.
Mr Binh retired last year because he has enrolled in a painting course.
questions.explain: Mệnh đề quan hệ không xác định (sau tên riêng) dùng who, có dấu phẩy, không dùng that; không lặp chủ ngữ 'he'; 'because' sai quan hệ nghĩa.

questions.q:
Choose the sentence that best combines each pair of sentences.
You should practise regularly. Otherwise, you will forget what you have learnt.
options: Unless you don't practise regularly, you will forget what you have learnt.
If you don't practise regularly, you will forget what you have learnt.
If you practise regularly, you will forget what you have learnt.
If you didn't practise regularly, you will forget what you have learnt.
questions.explain: Otherwise = nếu không → câu điều kiện loại 1: If you don't practise…, you will forget. 'Unless … don't' thừa phủ định; câu khẳng định ngược nghĩa; 'didn't … will' sai phối thì.

questions.q:
Choose the sentence that best combines each pair of sentences.
The course was very difficult. She finished it with excellent results.
options: Although the course was very difficult, she finished it with excellent results.
Because the course was very difficult, she finished it with excellent results.
Despite the course was very difficult, she finished it with excellent results.
The course was so difficult that she finished it with excellent results.
questions.explain: Hai ý tương phản → Although + mệnh đề. 'Because' và 'so … that' sai quan hệ nghĩa; 'Despite + mệnh đề' sai cấu trúc.

questions.q:
Choose the sentence that best combines each pair of sentences.
He did not take up learning a language earlier. He regrets it now.
options: He regrets taking up learning a language earlier.
He wishes he took up learning a language earlier.
He wishes he has taken up learning a language earlier.
He wishes he had taken up learning a language earlier.
questions.explain: Hối tiếc về quá khứ → wish + quá khứ hoàn thành: wishes he had taken up. 'took up', 'has taken up' sai thì; 'regrets taking up' ngược nghĩa (hối tiếc vì đã học).

questions.q: Choose the best option for blank (1).
questions.explain: That is why = đó là lý do vì sao (dẫn đến kết quả). what/which/whom không hợp ngữ pháp và nghĩa.

questions.q: Choose the best option for blank (10).
questions.explain: as long as = miễn là: không bao giờ quá muộn để học miễn là bạn ham hiểu biết và sẵn sàng thử. unless (trừ khi), although (mặc dù), so that (để mà) sai nghĩa.
